diocese: The Episcopal Diocese of Central New York
source: Prayers for the Week of... (diocesan weekly prayer posts)
sourceFile: Diocesan events page (https://cnyepiscopal.org/events/category/prayer/list/), each week its own post (e.g. https://cnyepiscopal.org/event/prayers-for-the-week-of-october-4th/). Automated fetch of the listing page was blocked by a bot-protection challenge page (a `sgcaptcha` redirect, confirmed by inspecting the raw response); the actual content for these 13 weeks was supplied directly by Josh, pasted from his own browser, 2026-09-29.
notes: Only 13 weeks were available (October 4 - December 27, 2026) -- matching the roster's own coverage note for this diocese ('Current and upcoming 2026 weeks'), a rolling window rather than a full-year document. No earlier-2026 weeks are transcribed here since none were supplied; this is the source's own real, partial scope, not a gap trimmed by this transcription.

Each week's post ends with an identical standing prayer for an end to gun violence ('God of mercy and compassion, who wept with Rachel as she lamented over her children...'), word-for-word the same every week -- per this corpus's established Great Lakes/Southwestern Virginia precedent for a repeated per-week constant, excluded from `entries` and disclosed here in full rather than repeated into all 13 weeks: 'God of mercy and compassion, who wept with Rachel as she lamented over her children -- be with us, who lament the plague of gun violence that lies heavy over our land. Open our eyes to see the ways we might transform the shadow of strife and death into the way of love and peace. Strengthen us to tirelessly care for one another, that we may truly find our security in the boundless love you call us to, and lead us all to your promised future, where no sword will be drawn against another, and no power known but the power of love. All this we ask through the name of your Son, Jesus Christ. Amen.'

Each week names, in order: 1-2 of the diocese's own parishes (`parish` subjects, clergy folded into `note`); another Episcopal Church diocese, elsewhere, 'and their bishop' (recorded as a `category` subject, not this schema's `diocese` type, since that type is reserved for scope-`communion` files per schema.json -- this file is scope `diocese`); and an Anglican Communion province/church body 'and their [prime bishop/archbishop/etc.]' (also `category`, same reasoning). Both cross-reference lines are the diocese's OWN prayer content, not this transcription inventing structure -- Central New York's own cycle deliberately widens beyond its own parishes every week.

Two apparent source typos preserved verbatim, per this corpus's standing rule: 'St. James Epsicopal Church' (November 8, evidently 'Episcopal') and 'their bishop, their bishop, the Rt. Rev. Rayford J. Ray' (November 8, an evident duplication in the source's own sentence, not an extraction artifact since this text was hand-copied from a live rendered page, not machine-extracted from a PDF).

'the Most Marinez Bassotto' (October 4) is missing 'Rev.' before the name, unlike every other entry's parallel phrasing ('the Most Rev. X') -- preserved exactly as the source gives it rather than silently corrected.
